title: kubeWAF WAF Proxy-Wasm plugin configuration
description: JSON shape emitted by the kubeWAF operator (internal/dataplane/config) and consumed by modsecurity-proxy-wasm (and coraza-proxy-wasm for the directives_map subset).

default_directives.description: Key into directives_map selecting the active profile.

oneOf.description: When directives_encoding is gzip+base64: base64(gzip(joined SecLang)).

directives_map.description: Named directive profiles (array, or compressed string).

directives_encoding.description: When set, directives_map values are base64(gzip(...)) blobs instead of string arrays. modsecurity-proxy-wasm inflates on configure. Coraza path keeps plain arrays.

directives_stats.description: Optional size metrics for compressed payloads (operator debug).

data_files.description: Basename → base64 (or gzip+base64) body for @pmFromFile runtime resolution. Preferred over embedded @crs-data catalog for matching basenames.

data_files_encoding.description: Encoding of data_files values. Default base64.

data_files_stats.description: Optional size metrics for injected phrase lists.

mode.description: When "kubewaf", the filter refuses allow_fallback and uses product defaults.

config_id.description: Stable ECDS / WAF identity, e.g. kubewaf/<namespace>/<name>.

allow_fallback.description: Dev-only: load minimal built-in rules if config fails. Forced false for mode=kubewaf.

metric_labels.description: Labels appended to all Envoy stats series (Envoy name-embedding style).

dual_prefix.description: Also emit kubewaf_waf.* core counters alongside modsecurity_proxy_wasm.*.

telemetry.description: Policy only. Wasm annotates requests when mode=Managed. No OTLP client fields.

mode.description: Managed: set export metadata for Envoy OTel access log. None: do not annotate.

sample_rate.description: Non-disruptive match sample probability as a decimal string (0.0–1.0).

sample_disruptive.description: Interrupt sample probability as a decimal string (0.0–1.0).

message.description: Local reply details string. Keep product-neutral; do not put vendor names here.

status.description: Override intervention HTTP status; 0 keeps ModSecurity status.

blocked_header.description: Generic marker header on deny local-replies. Empty string omits the header. Avoid product names.

rule_id_header.description: Response header name for the disrupting rule id when add_rule_id_header is true.

add_request_id_header.description: When true, include the correlated request id on deny local-replies.

request_id_header.description: Response header name for the request id when add_request_id_header is true.
